# Informed control diagnostic maintenance study

At commit 7898c211a973c430d84b4614205054b561e2ed68, read Issue #69, both native control adapters and the common lexer. No external model was invoked; exact model and sampling settings are unavailable. This is a curated diagnostic replay, not a blind model experiment or new language contract.

Earlier temporary probes first hit a missing-manifest project gate, then a manifest-only repair exposed the generic ampersand and short selected sector diagnostics. The unmodified earlier outputs are retained in prior-probes.json; their individual times were not captured and they are not timestamped session observations. This context follows those probes honestly. These official snapshots are fixed before the maintenance implementation.

Expect unsupported ampersands to retain the original one-byte parse span, H(ctrl q) to retain the native contract refusal and full original call span, and Z(ctrl q) to remain accepted. A syntax note must not infer the expression is quantum or mechanically replace & by ctrl. Only basis-sector evidence grants ctrl; excl is arbitrary coherent access. Phase kickback and entanglement remain allowed, and access exit is not restoration. No acceptance rule, evidence cache, formal discharge or qlippy work is introduced.
